summary: The assert module checks that given expressions are true and can show a custom message; it also works on Windows targets.
questions: How do I make a playbook fail if a condition isn't met?
Can I validate input variables at the start of a play?
Does assert work against Windows hosts?

answer_card.title: Validate conditions with assert
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.assert` fails the task if any expression in `that` is false, with an optional custom message. Works on Windows targets too.
